name: jira
description: Create and transition Blazemeter MOB Jira tickets — project MOB / board 5348, type Task, Product=Blazemeter, Scrum Team=Terra, active sprint, assignee = the repo owner, status In Review, plus caller-supplied labels (e.g. mend_orch).
